theories.claim: Planning variant fields are incompletely redacted, allowing potential secret material in variant values to leak via Redacted projection
theories.basis: internal/platform/config/redaction.go:54-69 redactPlanning redacts CodeContextVariant, ExecuteVariant, ReviewVariant, SmokeVariant but omits RequirementsVariant, SprintIndexVariant, TechnicalHandbookVariant, AreaReasoningVariant, ReasoningVariant, PlanVariant; all variants are model-adjacent free-form strings that may contain tokens/keys and are stored alongside redacted model fields
theories.verification_surface: static comparison of Planning struct definition in config.go:41-62 vs redactPlanning allowlist in redaction.go:54-69 and Sensitive/RedactValue logic
theories.confirmation_condition: Source shows at least one Planning variant field with no RedactValue call while its paired Model field is redacted, confirmed by line-by-line diff of struct fields vs redaction function
theories.refutation_condition: All Planning.*Model/*Variant pairs are passed through RedactValue or variant fields are proven non-sensitive by design contract and documentation
theories.inconclusive_condition: Redaction would require runtime value inspection to determine sensitivity and static allowlist alone is insufficient
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only code review of config.go Planning struct and redaction.go redactPlanning; no execution; cross-check with TestRedactSensitiveValues in config_test.go:79-99 for coverage

theories.claim: Workspace YAML parser may mis-handle QA duration/integer fields with quoting or inline comments, leading to parse errors or silent misconfiguration
theories.basis: config.go:197-268 loadFile uses naive strings.SplitN(line, ":",2) and Trim( value, '"') without stripping inline comments; QA timeout fields accept durations like "5m" and integer fields use strconv.Atoi; malformed env handling test at config_test.go:333-345 expects proper error wrapping but workspace file path has limited error context
theories.verification_surface: review of loadFile scanner loop, setQAField dispatch, setQAInteger error messages, and Validate vs Load precedence tests
theories.confirmation_condition: Static parser demonstrably fails on workspace yaml examples with quoted durations, trailing comments, or extra whitespace that user docs might encourage
theories.refutation_condition: Parser correctly handles all YAML forms used in documentation/tests and Validate provides clear field-specific errors for all QA fields
theories.inconclusive_condition: Requires actual Load() execution with crafted ultraplan.yml fixtures to observe parsing behavior
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Read-only analysis of loadFile parsing logic and existing tests TestQAConfigWorkspaceAndEnvironmentPrecedence and TestLoadPrecedenceAndValidation; no file mutation or execution
